_meta.name: OODA MAS Shared Knowledge Database
_meta.description: This database stores contextual, historical, and environmental knowledge used during the Orient phase of the OODA loop. It provides memory and pattern recognition to support reasoning before action.

baseline_environment.description: Represents the healthy steady-state environment for Zurich Premium Auto.

market_patterns.description: Seasonal surge in demand (e.g., holiday period).
market_patterns.recommended_strategy: Increase bids gradually while monitoring CPA.
market_patterns.risk_note: Avoid excessive aggression; CPC rises with demand.

market_patterns.description: Technical issue causes sudden CVR collapse.
market_patterns.risk_note: Continuing to spend during outage creates toxic spend.

market_patterns.recommended_strategy: Evaluate marginal CPA impact before raising bids.

market_patterns.description: Gaussian fluctuation in CPC or CVR.

historical_incidents.description: System reduced bids too aggressively due to 1-hour CVR drop.
historical_incidents.lesson_learned: Require confirmation window before major actions.

historical_incidents.description: System prioritized CPA efficiency too long and failed to finish budget.
historical_incidents.lesson_learned: Shadow price λ must dominate late in the day.

historical_incidents.description: System failed to scale during high CVR surge.
historical_incidents.lesson_learned: Increase bids cautiously during confirmed surges.

efficiency_relationships.cpa_sensitivity: CPA is inversely proportional to CVR.
efficiency_relationships.leakage_condition: When CPA > target and CVR < baseline, spend is toxic.
efficiency_relationships.bid_volume_tradeoff: Lower bids reduce CPA but risk inventory loss.
efficiency_relationships.budget_scaling_penalty: As spend approaches daily cap, CPC increases due to saturation.

utility_intuition.interpretation: The system values profitable leads highly but punishes inefficient and toxic spending.

noise_model_assumptions.implication: Short-term metric spikes may not indicate structural change.

stakeholder_expectations.system_requirement: All decisions must produce reasoning logs for audit.
